# anthropic_telemetry_destinations (Data Source)

Beta. Lists the organization's telemetry destinations, newest first (`GET /v1/organizations/telemetry_destinations`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_telemetry_destinations" "covering" {
  workspace_ids = ["wrkspc_01ABCDEF"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_ids` (List of String) Return only destinations that cover at least one of these workspaces (`wrkspc_...`). At most 100.

### Read-Only

- `telemetry_destinations` (Attributes List) Telemetry destinations of the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry_destinations))

<a id="nestedatt--telemetry_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telemetry_destinations`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the destination was created.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why the destination is disabled, or `null` when enabled.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name, or `null`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives deliveries.
- `endpoint_url` (String) Base URL of the collector's OTLP/HTTP endpoint.
- `header_names` (List of String) Names of the registered request headers. Values are never returned.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the destination (`tdst_...`).
- `last_error` (String) Most recent delivery error, or `null`.
- `last_error_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent delivery error, or `null`.
- `last_success_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent successful delivery, or `null`.
- `traces_content_mode` (String) What exported spans contain: `metadata_only` or `content`.
- `traces_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives traces.
- `traces_endpoint_url` (String) Full traces URL, or `null` when traces go to `endpoint_url` plus `/v1/traces`.
- `traces_max_content_bytes` (Number) Most bytes of content per span, or `null` when only the API's maximum applies.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last configuration or state change.
- `workspace_scope` (String) Which workspaces the destination covers: `all`, `include` or `exclude`.
